claims.text: RIPE x2 mo, then INH + RIF x4 or 7 mo (6–9 mo total).
claims.quote: These regimens for treating TB disease have an intensive phase of 2 months of isonaizid, rifampin, pyrazinamide, and ethambutol (2HRZE), followed by a continuation phase of either 4 or 7 months of isonaizid and rifampin (4HR or 7HR) for total of 6 to 9 months for treatment.
